title: Text To Speech (Rime)
description:
Converts incoming text into speech using the Rime text-to-speech API.
Calls the vendor API directly from the engine host over HTTPS and emits MP3 bytes on the audio lane.
Rime speakers are model-specific, so each model exposes its own curated speaker list; the API key falls back to the RIME_API_KEY environment variable when blank.
